scoreReasons: The key store at https://mcp.visa.com/.well-known/jwks is public and can be polled, but on 2026-10-11 it held one RSA sandbox key that does not match the specification's examples.
TAP is off-chain and defines no events, receipts or public logs.
Signature-Input parameters (keyid, tag, nonce, timestamps) are visible only to the merchant, the CDN and intermediaries on the path.
The Agentic Directory has no public list or endpoint, and no count of verifying merchants or signed requests is published.
The sample repository and its pull requests are public, which shows spec activity but not deployment.

public.how: HTTP GET returns a JWK Set; served with cache-control public, max-age=3600. Poll it to watch for key additions or removals.

public.where: GET /keys with a keyID parameter (host not named in the specification)
public.how: Returns one JWK with kty, kid, use, alg, n and e.
Unversioned pages; diff them over time to detect changes.
Commits, pull requests, issues and the GitHub advisories list.
Named merchants, issuers and CDNs with dates.

private.why: Seen only by the merchant, its CDN and intermediaries on the request path.
Personal data sent only to the merchant in the request body.
Card data for the merchant only.
Visa feeds TAP data into internal fraud models.
Exposed to the zone owner, for example through cf.bot_management.signed_agent on Enterprise Bot Management.
Bilateral calls between the agent and Visa under /vacp/v1.

indexerCaptures.signal: Key additions and removals in the Visa JWKS

indexerCaptures.from: GitHub API for visa/trusted-agent-protocol and the specification page

indexerCaptures.signal: Own-site TAP traffic (for a merchant or CDN)
